column2: Hey! Today, we're introducing something new in Pocket: Beast Mode.

No tabs. No switching windows. Just the news, the tools, and the sites you follow, all in one view.
So, how do we get there? Let's find out.
And to get there, we unlock... God Mode!
Meet God Mode. You don't drag windows around. You simply tell Pocket what you want.

Pick your account in the browser, then click Continue.
And you're back in Pocket, ready to go.
Now, in the bar at the bottom, type what you want.
Create a four by four grid of news websites. Technology on top, then world news, Mexico news, and culture at the bottom.
